svg.title: Earlier checkpoint: lobby recovery and Cross Fever reset
svg.desc: Historical behavior at commit 4b578bf. A departure remains pending until the service acknowledges it; failed requests retry. Reopening a menu-hosted match sends reconnect messages, while an intentional host exit ends the session. Board boot resets the Cross Fever gauge phase; ordinary match transitions and save/load preserve it. Historical local tests do not establish a four-machine internet playtest.
